title: Describing experiences and events
source: Language Learning Hub · original V4.4 teaching draft, not an external textbook
goal: Apply describing experiences and events in an original academic-English context and explain reasoning in coherent English
context: 描述一次活动体验，用具体感官与行动支撑评价。
grammar: 形容词应有可观察依据：welcoming 可由有人主动解释流程支持。used to 与 was used to 不同；前者讲过去习惯，后者讲已经习惯某事。
common_mistake: 把所有活动都描述成 amazing/beautiful 会削弱细节。

examples.note: 原文例句：结合本课知识讲解，辨认表达的功能与适用条件。

examples.text: That simple gesture made the atmosphere feel welcoming.

reading: The workshop took place in a small community studio. I hesitated at the door because everyone seemed to know where the tools were kept. A volunteer noticed and showed me how to prepare a piece of clay. That simple gesture made the atmosphere feel welcoming. During the session, we compared our uneven bowls and laughed at the different shapes. I left with an object that was far from professional but entirely my own. The strongest impression was the freedom to make mistakes without feeling judged.

questions.answer: A volunteer noticed the hesitation and explained the first step.

questions.prompt: Does far from professional mean professionally made ?
questions.answer: No, it means the opposite: it was not professional in quality.
questions.explanation: 识别短语意义，不能只抓 professional。
